title: Die Hard
description: NYPD detective John McClane flies to Los Angeles to reunite with his estranged wife only to find her office building seized by a charismatic German terrorist. Trapped on an upper floor he must use his wits and a pistol to pick off the criminals one by one.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland former prisoner Max teams up with Imperator Furiosa to escape a tyrannical warlord and his army. Their desperate chase across the desert becomes a fight for survival and redemption.

title: John Wick
description: After the death of his wife a retired hitman is pulled back into the criminal underworld when a mobsters son steals his car and kills his dog. The rampage that follows reminds everyone why his nickname is the Baba Yaga.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces his greatest challenge yet as the Joker a chaos-obsessed criminal mastermind unleashes a campaign of terror on Gotham City. The line between hero and vigilante blurs as the city descends into madness.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general is forced into slavery and becomes a gladiator who rises through the ranks of the arena. His ultimate goal is to seek revenge against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family.

title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
description: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team are in a race against time after a mission goes wrong and nuclear weapons fall into the hands of terrorist apostles. With the clock ticking Hunt must confront his past to prevent global catastrophe.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer named Neo discovers that reality as he knows it is a simulation created by intelligent machines. He joins a group of freedom fighters to overthrow the machines and free humanity.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: Archaeologist Indiana Jones is hired by the US government to find the Ark of the Covenant before the Nazis can harness its divine power. His globe-trotting quest is filled with booby traps snakes and narrow escapes.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: A cyborg from the future is sent back in time to protect a young John Connor from a more advanced liquid-metal assassin. Together they must prevent the apocalyptic future that awaits humanity.

title: Casino Royale
description: British secret agent James Bond earns his 00 status and embarks on his first mission to stop a terrorist financier at a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro. Along the way he falls in love only to face a devastating betrayal.

title: Superbad
description: Two socially awkward high school seniors try to make the most of their last weekend before graduation by attending a party and buying alcohol. Their mission spirals into a series of absurd misadventures that test their friendship.

title: The Hangover
description: Three friends wake up in Las Vegas with no memory of the previous night a missing groom and a tiger in their bathroom. They must retrace their steps and piece together the chaos to make it to the wedding on time.

title: Bridesmaids
description: Annie a down-on-her-luck single woman is asked to be the maid of honor for her best friend. Her life unravels as she competes with a wealthy bridesmaid and struggles to keep her friendships intact.

title: Groundhog Day
description: A cynical weatherman covering the annual Groundhog Day celebration finds himself trapped in a time loop reliving the same day over and over. He uses the endless repetition to improve himself and win over his producer.

title: Step Brothers
description: Two middle-aged men who still live with their parents are forced to become stepbrothers when their single parents marry and move in together. Their childish rivalry eventually turns into an unbreakable bond.

title: Dumb and Dumber
description: A pair of incredibly dim-witted friends embark on a cross-country trip to return a briefcase full of money to a beautiful woman. Along the way they unwittingly evade criminals who want the money back.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: The legendary concierge of a famous European hotel and his young lobby boy become entangled in a family feud over a priceless painting. The story unfolds through layers of narration spanning decades.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur and his knights embark on an absurd quest for the Holy Grail encountering killer rabbits taunting French soldiers and a three-headed knight. The entire adventure is a masterpiece of surreal British comedy.

title: School of Rock
description: A failed rock musician posing as a substitute teacher turns his strict prep school classroom into a rock band. He teaches his students to rebel through music while hiding the scheme from the school administration.

title: 21 Jump Street
description: Two underachieving cops are sent back to high school as undercover students to bust a drug ring. they struggle to fit in with modern teenagers while dealing with the trauma of reliving adolescence.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker wrongly convicted of murder forms an unlikely friendship with a fellow inmate during his decades-long imprisonment at Shawshank State Penitentiary. His quiet dignity and unwavering hope inspire everyone around him.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty seeks to transfer control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son. A sweeping saga of family loyalty power and the American underworld.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A simple man with a low IQ witnesses and unwittingly influences several defining historical events of the twentieth century. Through it all his only constant is his childhood friend Jenny.

title: The Social Network
description: The founding of Facebook is retold through the eyes of its creator Mark Zuckerberg as he navigates friendship betrayal and multiple lawsuits. The story explores ambition and the cost of success in the digital age.

title: Good Will Hunting
description: A janitor at MIT who is secretly a mathematical genius is discovered by a professor and sent to therapy to work through his emotional issues. With his therapist help he confronts his past and embraces his potential.

title: Whiplash
description: An ambitious young jazz drummer enrolls at a prestigious music school where he falls under the brutal tutelage of an abusive instructor. His obsessive pursuit of greatness pushes him to his physical and emotional limits.

title: Parasite
description: Two families from opposite ends of the economic spectrum become intertwined when the impoverished Kim clan infiltrates the wealthy Park household by posing as unrelated professionals. The arrangement leads to shocking and violent consequences.

title: 12 Angry Men
description: A jury of twelve men must decide the fate of a teenager accused of murder with a seemingly open-and-shut case. One juror casts a reasonable doubt vote forcing the others to examine the evidence more closely.

title: A Beautiful Mind
description: The true story of mathematician John Nash who made groundbreaking discoveries in game theory while battling schizophrenia. With the support of his wife he learns to manage his condition and eventually receives the Nobel Prize.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesmans wife leaves him and he becomes homeless while raising his young son alone. He lands an unpaid internship at a brokerage firm and must outwork everyone to secure a paid position.

title: Se7en
description: Two detectives one nearing retirement and one newly transferred hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as the inspiration for his gruesome murders. The investigation leads to a devastating conclusion that changes both detectives forever.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
description: A young FBI trainee seeks the help of the imprisoned cannibalistic serial killer Dr Hannibal Lecter to catch another serial killer who skins his victims. The psychological cat-and-mouse game that follows is tense and terrifying.

title: Gone Girl
description: A man becomes the prime suspect in his wifes mysterious disappearance on their fifth wedding anniversary. As the media circus intensifies secrets about both spouses emerge revealing a twisted game of manipulation.

title: Zodiac
description: In late 1960s San Francisco a cryptic serial killer taunts the police and media with coded letters and ciphers. Three men a cartoonist a reporter and a detective become obsessed with unmasking the Zodiac killer.

title: Shutter Island
description: Two US marshals travel to a remote asylum for the criminally insane to investigate the disappearance of a patient who was being held in a locked cell. As the investigation deepens reality begins to unravel for the lead marshal.

title: Prisoners
description: When two young girls go missing on Thanksgiving a desperate father takes matters into his own hands after the police release the primary suspect. The hunt for the children exposes the dark edges of a quiet community.

title: The Sixth Sense
description: A troubled young boy who communicates with spirits is treated by a child psychologist who is determined to help him. The psychologist discovers a shocking truth about himself that changes everything.

title: Memento
description: A man with anterograde amnesia who cannot form new memories uses polaroid photos and tattoos to hunt for his wifes murderer. The story is told in reverse chronological order immersing the audience in his fractured reality.

title: Oldboy
description: A man is mysteriously imprisoned in a sealed room for fifteen years with only a television for company. When he is suddenly released he sets out on a violent quest for revenge against his unknown captor.

title: North by Northwest
description: A New York advertising executive is mistaken for a government agent and pursued across the country by a ruthless spy organization. His escape leads to a dramatic climax on the faces of Mount Rushmore.

title: Inception
description: A professional thief who specializes in stealing secrets from peoples dreams is offered a chance to erase his criminal record if he can perform the impossible task of planting an idea into someones subconscious. He assembles a team for one last job.

title: Interstellar
description: In a future where Earth is becoming uninhabitable a former NASA pilot embarks on a journey through a wormhole near Saturn to find a new home for humanity. Time dilation and cosmic distances threaten to sever his connection to his family forever.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: Officer K a new generation blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what remains of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard a former blade runner who has been missing for decades.

title: Arrival
description: When mysterious alien spacecraft land across the globe a linguist is recruited to communicate with the extraterrestrial visitors. Her efforts to understand their language reshape her perception of time itself.

title: Alien
description: The commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a desolate moon and unwittingly brings aboard a deadly extraterrestrial organism. The creature stalks the crew one by one as they fight for survival in the deep vacuum of space.

title: Ex Machina
description: A young programmer is invited to administer the Turing test on an advanced humanoid AI named Ava at a reclusive billionaires remote estate. As the testing progresses the lines between creator creation and captor become dangerously blurred.

title: District 9
description: When a massive alien ship arrives over Johannesburg South Africa its inhabitants are placed in a segregated internment camp called District 9. A bureaucratic agent becomes infected with alien DNA and must rely on the very beings he once oppressed.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut is left behind on Mars after his crew evacuates during a violent storm believing him dead. He must use his scientific knowledge to survive on the hostile planet until a rescue mission can be launched years later.

title: Looper
description: In the year 2074 the mob sends its targets back in time to be killed by assassins called loopers. When one looper discovers that his future self has been sent back for termination he hesitates and sets off a chain of events that could alter the timeline.

title: The Terminator
description: A cyborg assassin is sent back in time from a post-apocalyptic future to kill Sarah Connor before her unborn son can lead the human resistance against the machines. A human soldier is also sent back to protect her at all costs.

title: The Shining
description: Jack Torrance a struggling writer becomes the winter caretaker of a remote haunted hotel and brings his wife and young son along. As isolation takes hold supernatural forces drive him toward a violent breakdown.

title: Get Out
description: A young black man visits his white girlfriends family estate for the first time and becomes uneasy about the strangely welcoming behavior of the residents and staff. He uncovers a horrifying conspiracy that threatens his existence.

title: Hereditary
description: After the death of her secretive mother a woman discovers dark and disturbing secrets about her family lineage. Her teenage son who has a troubled relationship with her becomes the focus of a malevolent supernatural force.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their secluded Rhode Island farmhouse. The case becomes one of the most harrowing in their files as the entity fights to keep its hold on the family.

title: It Follows
description: A teenage girl is pursued by an invisible supernatural entity that relentlessly follows her after a sexual encounter. The entity can take the form of anyone and will keep walking toward her until it kills her or she passes it to someone else.

title: A Quiet Place
description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by blind creatures with hyper-sensitive hearing a family must live in complete silence to survive. When a new threat emerges they are forced to find creative ways to fight back without making a sound.

title: The Exorcist
description: When a twelve-year-old girl begins exhibiting bizarre and violent behavior her desperate mother seeks help from two Catholic priests. They perform a dangerous exorcism to expel the powerful demon possessing the child.

title: Halloween
description: On Halloween night a young babysitter and her friends are stalked by the escaped mental patient Michael Myers who murdered his sister on the same night fifteen years earlier. He returns to his hometown to continue his killing spree.

title: Rosemarys Baby
description: A young couple moves into a historic Manhattan apartment building with a dark reputation. The wife becomes pregnant under sinister circumstances and begins to suspect that her neighbors are part of a satanic cult with designs on her unborn child.

title: The Babadook
description: A widowed mother struggles to raise her troubled son who is terrified of a monster he believes lives in their house. When a mysterious pop-up book appears featuring a creature called the Babadook the line between imagination and reality dissolves.

title: The Notebook
description: An elderly man reads a love story to a fellow nursing home resident recounting the passionate summer romance between a poor mill worker and a wealthy debutante in 1940s South Carolina. Their love endures through war class differences and Alzheimers.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
description: After a painful breakup a man undergoes a medical procedure to erase all memories of his ex-girlfriend. During the process he relives their relationship and realizes he wants to keep the memories after all.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: The headstrong Elizabeth Bennet navigates issues of manners morality and marriage in Georgian-era England. Her evolving relationship with the seemingly proud Mr Darcy challenges both their prejudices about love and class.

title: La La Land
description: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress meet and fall in love in Los Angeles while pursuing their artistic dreams. Their relationship is tested by the demands of their careers and the sacrifices required for success.

title: Titanic
description: A wealthy young woman aboard the ill-fated RMS Titanic falls in love with a penniless artist from steerage. Their forbidden romance unfolds against the backdrop of the ships tragic sinking in the North Atlantic.

title: Before Sunrise
description: A young American man and a French woman meet on a train in Europe and decide to spend the night exploring Vienna together. Their conversations about life love and philosophy form an intimate connection that may never be repeated.

title: When Harry Met Sally
description: Two friends debate whether men and women can ever truly be just friends over the course of more than a decade. Their evolving relationship from mutual disdain to deep friendship and eventually love is filled with witty banter and genuine emotion.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
description: An American-born Chinese economics professor travels to Singapore to meet her boyfriends incredibly wealthy family for the first time. She must navigate jealous socialites disapproving relatives and immense cultural pressure to prove her worth.

title: 500 Days of Summer
description: A would-be architect reflects on his relationship with a free-spirited woman who does not believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative jumps through the highs and lows of their relationship showing both perspectives.

title: Amelie
description: A shy waitress in Paris decides to secretly improve the lives of the people around her after discovering a hidden treasure in her apartment. Her anonymous acts of kindness lead her on a journey to find her own happiness.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl named Chihiro wanders into a magical world of spirits and gods where her parents are turned into pigs. She must work at a bathhouse run by the witch Yubaba to find a way to break the curse and return home.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a space ranger action figure becomes his owners new favorite toy. The rivals must set aside their jealousy and work together when they are both lost and must find their way back home.

title: The Lion King
description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his uncles murderous plot kills his father and blames him for the tragedy. He must overcome his guilt and fear to reclaim his rightful place as king of the Pride Lands.

title: Up
description: An elderly widower fulfills his late wifes dream of adventure by tying thousands of balloons to his house and flying to South America. An enthusiastic young stowaway joins his journey teaching him that life is worth living after loss.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A overprotective clownfish father must traverse the entire Pacific Ocean to rescue his son Nemo who has been captured by a scuba diver. Along the way he befriends a forgetful blue tang named Dory who helps him navigate the dangers of the deep.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
description: Teenager Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his dimension after being bitten by a radioactive spider. He teams up with Spider-People from alternate universes to stop a threat that could destroy all of reality.

title: Inside Out
description: Eleven-year-old Riley moves to a new city and her emotions Joy Sadness Anger Fear and Disgust struggle to help her adjust. The emotions must learn to work together as Joy realizes that sadness plays a crucial role in healing.

title: Wall-E
description: In a future where Earth has been abandoned a solitary trash-compacting robot named Wall-E discovers a tiny plant that could signal the planets restoration. He embarks on a space journey with a sleek probe robot named Eve to save humanity.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
description: Two young sisters move to the countryside with their father to be closer to their hospitalized mother. They discover that the nearby forest is home to magical creatures including the gentle giant Totoro who grants them extraordinary adventures.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
description: A young Viking named Hiccup defies his tribes centuries-old tradition of dragon slaying when he befriends a wounded dragon he names Toothless. Together they prove that understanding dragons is more powerful than fighting them.
